title: Repeated Walsh maxima for APN functions
summary: Determine whether every APN function satisfies the repeated-maximum Walsh condition used for the source nonlinearity bound.

formal_statement.body: Does every APN function $F$ satisfy the condition of Corollary 3, namely that the maximum absolute value of its nonzero-component Walsh spectrum is attained for at least two distinct nonzero inputs? If not, characterize and, if possible, determine all source-defined $(n,m)$-functions that fail this condition.

scope.domain: APN vectorial Boolean functions and component Walsh spectra
assumptions: The Corollary 3 Walsh-spectrum condition is the source condition
scope.unresolved_remainder: Decide the condition for every APN function; if it fails, characterize and, if possible, determine all source-defined $(n,m)$-functions that do not satisfy it.

progress.summary: The TIT source explicitly states this unresolved problem and fixes its mathematical scope.
